senses.gloss:
अणु a. (णु-ण्वी f.) [अण्-उन्] Minute, small, little,
 atomic (opp. स्थूल, महत्); अणोरणीयान् Bg. 8. 9; सर्वोप्ययं
 नन्वणुः Bh. 3. 26 insignificantly small; अण्वपि भयम् Ms. 6. 40;
 अण्वपि याच्यमानः Pt. 4. 26 asked but an atom, a very small quantity,
 न कन्यायाः पिता विद्वान् गृह्णीयात् शुल्कमण्वपि Ms. 3. 51.

अणु + .{@-णु@} n. the fourth part of a Mātrā.
.━{@Comp.@}: अण्वन्तः, अणुतैलम्, अणुभा, अणुमात्र, अणुरेणुः, अणुरेवती, अणुवादः, अणुवीक्षणम्, अणुव्रतानि, अणुव्रीहिः

अणु + .{@-णुः@}
—1 An atom, a very small particle (an exceedingly small measure); the
 mote in a sunbeam, the smallest perceptible quantity; अस्थूलमनण्वह्नण्वमदीर्घं
 ब्रह्म; अणुं पर्वतीकृ Bh. 2. 78 to magnify; cf. also ‘To make mountains of mole-hills’
.
—2 An atom of time (व्यञ्जनमर्धमात्रा तदर्धम् अणु); it is said
 to be 54,675,000th part of a Muhūrta (48 minutes).
—3 N. of Śiva. —4 N. of very small grain such as सर्षप, चीनक &c.,
 अनणुषु दशमांशोऽणुष्वथैकादशांशः Līlā.
अणु + -तैलम् N. of a medicinal oil.
अणु + -भा [अण्वी सूक्ष्मा भा प्रभा यस्याः सा] lightning.
अणु + -मात्र a. [अणुः परिमाणं यस्य अणु-मात्रच्] of the size of an atom.

अणु + -रेवती [अणुः सूक्ष्मा रेवतीतारेव] N. of a plant
[]
 (दन्तीवृक्ष) Croton Polyandrum.

अणु + -वादः the doctrine of atoms, atomic theory, the theory that all
 material substances are primarily atoms and secondarily aggregates, and
 that all atoms are eternal.

अणु + -वीक्षणम् [ष˚ त˚]
—1 minute observation, observation of very minute parts.
—2 [अणुः सूक्ष्मो वीक्ष्यते अनेन करणे ल्युट्] an instrument, like the
 microscope, enabling one to discern the smallest objects.
अणु + -व्रतानि N. of the twelve smaller vows of laymen adhering to the Jain faith.
अणु + -व्रीहिः [कर्म˚] a fine sort of grain, rice &c.

अणिमन् m. [अणु-इमनिच्], अणुता, -त्वम्
—1 Minuteness, smallness, thinness, leanness, fineness.
—2 Atomic nature.
—3 The superhuman power of becoming as small as an atom, one of the 8
 powers or Siddhis of Śiva; (अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा ।
 ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च तथा कामावसायिता).

अणिमन् m. [अणु-इमनिच्], अणुता, -त्वम्
—1 Minuteness, smallness, thinness, leanness, fineness.
—2 Atomic nature.
—3 The superhuman power of becoming as small as an atom, one of the 8
 powers or Siddhis of Śiva; (अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा ।
 ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च तथा कामावसायिता).

अणुक a. [स्वार्थे कन्]
—1 Very small, atomic.
—2 Subtle, too fine.
—3 Acute.
अणुक + .{@-कः@} A small kind of grain. See अणु.

अणूभू^1 €1 P. To become minute or atomic.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170124. note: By some grammar rule the vowel lengthens.
